primary_selection_rule: First five consecutive 5 Hz samples of the longest exact-six-ID run, for set-three point 13 (win) and point 34 (loss), selected before frame-level ground adjudication; equal 0.8 s spans.
revised_selection_rule: Revised exploratory phase candidate: five consecutive 5 Hz frames ending near observed opponent front-court action in each point; this revision follows the first-window failure, and cannot support a prespecified outcome test.

decision: Airborne frames remain usable as image-plane box-centre candidates; height and pose still affect pixel centres. The initially fixed windows are not phase matched. The revised opponent-attack candidates are exploratory, with one point per outcome. Neither selection supports a winner association, and neither supplies certified court-floor positions for metre-valued metrics.
